info.name: TrainerTwin API
info.description: Add learners, read credits, assign published role plays, and read practice results for one organization. The role-play path is /scenarios; send its slug as scenario. A session returns that same slug as agentSlug. A learner's role is always member. Set apiKey and replace example IDs. For each new credit grant set a fresh creditRequestKey, then keep that same key and body if you retry. This collection does not buy credits, author role plays, or start calls.

variable.description: Fresh for each intended grant; reuse unchanged after timeouts. Do not use a dynamically regenerated key for retries.

request.description: Published role plays in dashboard order. The path is /scenarios. Twins and archived role plays are omitted. Save slug and send it as scenario.
One published role play. data is dashboard display content and is not a stable call contract.
Enabled org learners, including creditsGiven and creditsLeft. Optional exact email filter.
Adds the learner immediately with 30 starting credits once. Repeat adds return the existing learner. No invitation acceptance step.
A shared account cannot be renamed by an org key; same-name updates are no-ops.
Disables access and ends live calls. Does not delete the account or history. Repeat DELETE is 204. calls_not_ended means send DELETE again.
Requires users:read. balanceMinutes is what can still be allocated. One credit is one minute. Does not buy credits.
Given, used and remaining minutes for one enabled org learner.

Requires users:write. Adds 30 minutes from the org balance. Keep creditRequestKey and body unchanged on retries; change the key only for a new intended grant. 201 is new, 200 is replay, 409 idempotency_conflict means the same key was used with different input. Replays do not send a second email.
Filter by userId or email, never both. Optional scenario is the role-play slug.
Supply userId or email, never both. Email can add a new learner with 30 starting credits. Existing open pairs return unchanged without another email.
Use practiceCount/lastPracticedAt for usage; pending remains open after practice.
Set userId or email, or change scenario. Existing source history stays with it. A repeated move returns the target unchanged.
Only pending links with no sessions can be deleted. Practised links and repeated deletes return 404. No credit refund.
Read-only role-play sessions. Optional scenario, assignmentId, status, from/to filters. Disabled learners' history remains visible; deleted/twin sessions are excluded.
Stored transcript, report, reportStatus, evidence, and one-hour recording URLs. agentSlug is the role-play slug. This read does not generate a report.
